name: Final Passage
summary: You have passed Parqual Fintallas's test and all that came before it. Now he sends you to Dorn Plainstalker in Thousand Needles, who will judge whether your mind, body and spirit have grown strong enough to earn honour.

sections.title: Back to the Weathered Nook
sections.body: Dorn Plainstalker began the Test of Faith, and its trials now reach their final step. He waits in the Weathered Nook, in a cave reached by a ramp north of Freewind Post. Parqual Fintallas urges you to keep the balance you have shown through the trials.

sections.title: Dorn's Welcome
sections.body: Dorn Plainstalker says many moons have passed since your first leap set you on this path. You have been away from his home for a long while. He finds you stronger and more enlightened than before, and is pleased. Dorn says you deserve honour for seeing his tests through to the end.

faq.q: Who sends you on this final step?
faq.answer: Parqual Fintallas tells you that you have passed his test and all that came before it.
Return to Dorn Plainstalker in Thousand Needles. He waits in the Weathered Nook, in a cave reached by a ramp north of Freewind Post.
Test of Lore comes before this as an earlier trial in the same chain.

faq.q: What was the very first step of this journey?
faq.answer: Dorn Plainstalker gave you Test of Faith in the Weathered Nook. This is the chain's final step.

faq.q: Why does Parqual send you back to Dorn?
faq.answer: Parqual says Dorn will notice how you have changed and judge whether your mind, body and spirit are strong enough for honour.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you face this chain of trials, which ends with Dorn Plainstalker.
